split: first 10 lexicographically sorted qualifying LibriSpeech test-clean speakers, 3 clips each; first 4 speakers calibration (12 clips), remaining 6 evaluation (18 clips)
layers: floor(N/4), floor(N/2), N-1 encoder layers, first invocation during complete ASR
comparison: calibration first instrumented run per clip, pooled within-class diagonal scale (floor 1e-6), nearest per-model centroid by mean standardized squared distance; no feature selection or threshold search
repeat_distance: RMS standardized feature delta using calibration scale
baseline: same calibration procedure on output-only numeric features: words per second, mean and std of word duration, mean positive interword gap; no formatting/identity/shape/runtime inputs
precision: Parakeet float32, Whisper fp16 (official transcribe fp16=True)
decoding: Parakeet greedy_batch; Whisper English transcription temperature 0, no fallback, no beam/best-of, no previous-text conditioning
